tasks.label: Fix Font Awesome stylesheet line
tasks.command: $p='html\index.html'; $lines=Get-Content $p; for($i=0;$i -lt $lines.Count;$i++){ if($lines[$i] -match 'Font Awesome icons'){ if($i+1 -lt $lines.Count){ $lines[$i+1]='    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../css/all.min.css">' } } }; Set-Content -Path $p -Value $lines

tasks.label: Improve products responsive CSS
Contain products section content
tasks.command: $cssPath='css\main .css'; $css=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($cssPath); $css=$css.Replace(' height: 100vh;`r`n margin: 20PX 0;',' height: auto;`r`n min-height: 100vh;`r`n margin: 20px 0;'); $css=$css.Replace(' height: 37%;',' height: 300px;',1); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($cssPath,$css); $htmlPath='html\index.html'; $html=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($htmlPath); $html=$html.Replace('',''); $html=$html.Replace('$1109/span>','$1109'); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($htmlPath,$html)

tasks.label: Fix product search layout
tasks.command: $p='css\main .css'; $css=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($p); $css=$css.Replace('    display: grid;`r`n    grid-template-areas: "con con con con ";','    display: block;'); $css=$css.Replace('    display: grid;`n    grid-template-areas: "con con con con ";','    display: block;'); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($p,$css); Get-Content $p | Select-Object -Skip 558 -First 12
